The next economy needs power. AI, energy security and electrification are changing what the world needs to build. See the demand behind the infrastructure. AI needs dependable electricity. Data centres used an estimated 485 TWh globally in 2025. The IEA projects around 950 TWh by 2030. Energy security changes the equation. Oil supply disruptions strengthen the case for diversification and EVs, alongside investment in generation, grids and storage.
